edits.new:
- The ACE read is bounded by the timeout the legacy story fixes: 2 seconds per call, with the batching of `rwb.ace.plan.batch-size` = 500 and `rwb.ace.plan.timeout-ms` = 2000 as properties, not code (DP-11).
- The plan status passes from rwb-integration to rwb-case through the per-case operation: the plan-status step of DailyCaseRun calls `GET /api/recovery/integration/v1/cases/{caseId}/plan-status` once per case inside the `readPlanStatus` activity, with its page size and bounded concurrency taken from `rwb.ace.plan.batch-size` = 500 and its timeout from `rwb.ace.plan.timeout-ms` = 2000. No batch operation is used; the read of ACE stays with rwb-integration on its own base.
